C-482 No.327 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
applicant.
Mr. Rohit Dhyani, Brief Holder for the State 
of Uttarakhand.
Let notices be issued to respondent no.2,
through the office of Regional Transport Officer, 
Haridwar.
Notices on behalf of respondent no.3, is 
being accepted by the Government Advocate. 
Respondent no.1 has already filed, their 
counter affidavit to which rejoinder is still awaited.
The counsel for the applicant will take steps 
for serving respondent no.2, within a period of one 
week from today.
Respondent nos.2 & 3 may file their counter 
affidavits, within a period of three weeks and the 
applicant too would ensure to file a rejoinder 
affidavit to the counter affidavit of respondent no.1, 
within the aforesaid period.
List thereafter. 
Interim order of permitting the applicant to 
move an appropriate adjournment application 
before the trial court as granted on 18.04.2018,
would continue to operate till next date of listing.
Accordingly, the Interim Order Extension 
Application No.01 of 2022 would stand disposed 
of. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 02.09.2022
